title: MCT control-plane envelope
description: Compact control-plane message exchanged between B and A. Design ref: §6.1, §8.1, §8.2. Carries references and routing metadata only — never prompts, excerpts, responses, or summaries inline (invariant 3).

v.description: Protocol version. Mismatch is rejected during negotiation (§23 Protocol).

type.description: Message type. Direction and meaning defined in §8.2.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-session sequence. Stale/duplicate/future values are rejected or deterministically buffered (§15.1).

object.description: Opaque object handle. Required for message types that reference a payload object (validated at the application layer per §8.2, not by this schema).

sha256.description: Digest of the referenced object. Resolver verifies before exposing bytes (invariant 4).

media_type.description: IANA/vendor media type of the referenced object.

bytes.description: Byte count of the referenced object; used for preflight budgeting.

idempotency_key.description: Replay key. Replays return the original decision/result and never double-render or double-infer (§15.2).

error_code.description: Present only when type == 'error'. Detailed body lives in a pointed error_detail object, never inline (§6.1).

epoch.description: Epoch identifier for one continuous A runtime/context lineage (§12.3).

pointer.description: Opaque, session-scoped object handle. NOT a filesystem path (invariant 5). No bearer secret is embedded (§7.2).
